name: sol-advisor
description: Turn cost-aware Sol-led orchestration on or off for one Codex chat, keep every new chat off by default, prefer the minimum sufficient direct answer, route justified implementation to Terra / High or Luna / Max, and report the route.

interface.shortDescription: Minimize tokens and time, answering directly or routing justified work to Terra / High or Luna / Max.
interface.longDescription: Activate Sol Advisor once for the current Codex chat in plain language or with the literal skill invocation. Direct ON/OFF markers in that chat preserve state across its later requests, while plugin state, memory, summaries, and every other chat are ignored. GPT-5.6 Sol / High treats minimum sufficient outcome, total token cost, and total elapsed time as its first routing gates. It answers read-only or small requests directly and automatically chooses a justified implementation route only when delegation is cheaper or necessary. Native work uses GPT-5.6 Terra / High for a settled specification plus a fresh Sol reviewer; app-task work uses a user-visible GPT-5.6 Luna / Max task through list_projects, list_threads, create_thread, wait_threads, read_thread, and send_message_to_thread. One primary adherence checkpoint occurs during implementation only when risk, ambiguity, external access, scope growth, or budget overrun warrants it.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Sol Advisor on” in this chat when you want Sol-led routing; otherwise it stays off.
